title: Fish Taco Foil Packets
description: Cod fillets steamed in foil with peppers, corn and jalapeño, ready to flake into tacos.
steps: Divide the fish, pepper, corn and jalapeño between foil packets with a squeeze of lime.
Seal and bake at 200C for 18-20 minutes.
Flake the fish into warm tortillas with cilantro and extra lime.

source.label: Adapted from Skinnytaste fish taco foil packets

notes: Cooking in sealed foil keeps the fish moist with zero risk of overcooking — great for a first attempt at fish.
